# BH Locksmith Metro Detroit

> Licensed 24/7 locksmith serving all of Metro Detroit, Michigan. Licensed & insured. Residential, commercial, automotive, smart locks, access control, safes.

## About

BH Locksmith Metro Detroit is a licensed mobile locksmith company headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. We dispatch licensed & insured technicians 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to every city in Metro Detroit. Typical on-site arrival is 15–30 minutes.

- Business name: BH Locksmith Metro Detroit
- License: Licensed & Insured
- Phone: (313) 236-4558
- Email: info@bhlocksmithmetrodetroit.com
- Hours: 24/7
- Service area: All of Metro Detroit, MI (Detroit, Warren, Sterling Heights, Troy, Dearborn, Livonia, Royal Oak, Southfield, Farmington Hills, Pontiac, Canton, Westland, and every surrounding city in Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties).

## Services

- 24-hour emergency lockouts (home, business, vehicle)
- Residential locksmith (rekey, new locks, master keys, deadbolts)
- Commercial locksmith (storefront, glass doors, panic hardware, access control)
- Automotive locksmith (car keys, fobs, transponders, ignition repair)
- Smart and keypad locks (installation, setup, integration)
- Access control systems (keypads, fobs, mobile credentials, intercoms)
- Safe locksmith (combination changes, lockouts, repair, installation)
- Specialty hardware (high-security cylinders, restricted keyways)
